meta.name: Earth Bridge
meta.description: Lands with a thump and grows a causeway of rammed earth back towards you, from where it hit to where you stand, never too steep to drive. Bridge a valley, ramp up a cliff to a better firing spot, or lay a road across a crater to drive over to a ledge. Piers drop to the ground under it where they can reach; a long span with nothing below may break off. Does no damage.
